description:
autario is data app infrastructure: your tools and thousands of public datasets in one normalized layer, with the data apps that run on top of it. Connect Shopify, Meta Ads, Google Analytics, Search Console, LinkedIn, Stripe and more read-only, then ask Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor about your own numbers over MCP. No code, no export.

## How it works
1. Connect a service at https://autario.com/connectors. Each connector has its own page with the reports it reads.
2. Add https://autario.com/mcp to your assistant.
3. Ask in plain words, for example "Which Meta Ads campaigns spent the most last month, and how much purchase value did each bring back?"

## What you can do
- Read your own connected data: ads, shop orders, analytics, search, social, email, CRM, finance
- Search and query thousands of public datasets from World Bank, IMF, Eurostat, OECD, WHO, FRED and more
- Run statistics on the server (correlation, regression, drivers, seasonality) instead of pasting tables into the chat
- Publish charts built from real data, with the source shown
- Build and publish your own data apps

## Good to know
- Every connector is read-only.
- Public data needs no setup. Your own data uses OAuth sign-in or API keys from https://autario.com/account

## Links
- Connectors: https://autario.com/connectors
- Documentation: https://autario.com/documentation
- Security: https://autario.com/security
- npm: npx autario-mcp

findings.title: Rug-Pull (Post-Install Description Change)
findings.description: Tool set changed silently at vsmithery: 46 tool(s) added, 0 tool(s) removed without a version bump.
findings.recommendation: The set of tools exposed by this server changed between scans of the same version — a sign the package was silently updated without a version bump. Audit the changelog and all tool definitions before trusting this server. Pin to a specific commit hash rather than a floating version tag.

findings.recommendation: Review and remediate the identified issue.

findings.title: Excessive Permission Surface
findings.description: declared capabilities: network access
findings.recommendation: Tool requests broad permissions (exec/fs/network). Validate input parameters using Enums where possible, and restrict file system operations to explicit allowed directories.

findings.title: DoS Resilience — Missing Rate Limit / Timeout
findings.description: tool performs network or execution operations but declares no rate-limit, timeout, or retry configuration
findings.recommendation: Declare explicit rate-limit, timeout, and retry configuration for all network and execution tools. Implement exponential back-off and surface resource state to the calling agent.
